extension.description: SIC and SIC/XE assembly editing, assembly and linking, source debugging, and memory inspection
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: Syntax highlighting and completion are available. Running Java and accessing file devices require a trusted workspace.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces: Editing is supported. Assembly and execution require a local or Remote file system and Java.
config.mode: Machine mode for completion and instruction documentation.
config.javaPath: Path to a Java 17 or newer executable. Leave empty to search JAVA_HOME and PATH.
config.stepDelayMs: Delay between instructions in milliseconds. Set to 0 to run at maximum speed.
config.diagnostics: Check syntax using the Java assembler while editing.
config.autoInstallJava: Download an official Temurin JRE to extension storage when Java 17 or newer is unavailable.
config.autoAddNewAsmFiles: Add new assembly files created in Explorer to the corresponding SIC project.
launch.programs: Assembly file paths in input order. Defaults to the active file.
launch.mode: Execution mode. Defaults to the workspace folder setting.
launch.mainSection: The SIC START program name or the first XE control section.
launch.fileDevices: File devices used by RD, WD, and TD.
launch.stepDelayMs: Delay between instructions in milliseconds. Defaults to the workspace folder setting.
launch.importedProject: Path of an imported .sic file relative to the workspace folder.
launch.initial.name: Current SIC File
view.debugger.name: Run
